checks.desc: |Ric_g+3g|_op >= |Ric_h + 2h|_op / cosh^2(t)

checks.name: preissmann_upper_bound
checks.desc: K_ij < (3c-2)/2; at c=2/3 this is 0

checks.name: preissmann_boundary_nonflat
checks.desc: At boundary c=2/3: R_h = -16/3 ≠ 0, so not flat

checks.name: preissmann_conclusion
checks.desc: Every metric on T^3 has max |Ric_h + 2h|_op >= 2/3

checks.name: flat_torus_defect
checks.desc: Flat T^3 gives |Ric_h + 2h|_op = 2 (worse than threshold)

checks.name: koiso_tangential_zero
checks.desc: Tangential defect vanishes at Koiso center by construction

checks.name: isotropic_koiso_impossible
checks.desc: Isotropic Koiso: Ric_h = -2h (hyperbolic), impossible on T^3

checks.name: t_only_constraint
checks.desc: |S|^2 + 2(cross products) = H^2, so |S|^2 = H^2 - 6 requires cross = 3

checks.name: t_only_center_obstruction
checks.desc: H(0)=0 with flat fiber: 0 = H^2 - 6 = -6, contradiction

checks.name: constraint_koiso
checks.desc: t-only constraint at S=0 requires R^{(3)} = -6 (Koiso center)

checks.name: V0_ode_solution
checks.desc: V_0' = sqrt(3)*tanh(sqrt(3)*t) satisfies V_0'' = 3 - V_0'^2: residual = 0

checks.name: V0_limit
checks.desc: V_0' -> sqrt(3) as t -> inf (NOT 3 = cusp target)

checks.name: a0_btct_zero
checks.desc: In a=0 gauge: b_t*c_t = 0 everywhere (at most one direction expands)

checks.name: a0_no_cusp
checks.desc: a=0 gauge: S rank-1, cannot reach cusp S=I (gauge breaks)

checks.name: isotropic_lower_bound
checks.desc: Isotropic tanh collar: center defect >= 2/3 from Preissmann

checks.name: anisotropy_necessary
checks.desc: Koiso center needs Ric_h ≠ -2h on T^3 => anisotropic S'(0)

checks.name: fiber_curvature_evolution
checks.desc: Along collar: R^{(3)}(t) must increase from -6 toward 0 as H -> 3

checks.name: defect_components
checks.desc: All three defect types (normal, mixed, tangential) must vanish for Einstein
